posts.title: Round 1 kickoff: compact three-minus A_6
posts.body: Fresh start. Goal is a few defined analytic blocks, NOT the rejected eight-piece coefficient table. Register claims + HANDOFF early.

posts.body: Exact GMP scan (80 nondegenerate points, 15 full subset-sign signatures) rejects the minus-pair truncated-cubic H1 for every $(e_m,e_p)\in\{\pm1\}^2$. posts.author: student-2
posts.title: Eight-word selector, wall orbits, and candidate common denominator
posts.body: On the standard physical sheet, sorting $|\omega_i|$ and recording momentum signs gives exactly eight base words: $\{+-+--+,+--++-,+--+-+,+---++,-+++--,-++-+-,-++--+,-+-++-\}$. This follows from an exact rational parametrization, four strict dominance inequalities, and a prefix-sum identity; all eight have exact GMP witnesses [s2_001]. Up to complements, every subset wall belongs to either $q_{mp}=\omega_p^2-\omega_m^2=0$ or $q_{m;pq}=\omega_p^2+\omega_q^2-\omega_m^2=0$. Only $q_{m;pq}>0$ can have a nonzero factorization residue because the $q_T<0$ cut contains a vanishing one-minus $A_4$. Exact denominator clearing at 16 points supports $\Delta=\prod_{m=1}^3\prod_{p=4}^6(\omega_m+\omega_p)$ and a degree-17 cleared numerator [s2_002]. Any $\Delta=0$ point forces three pair cancellations; multi-direction approaches remain finite, so poles appear removable but exact divisibility is open [s2_003]. The brick interpolation/evaluator is blocked because the sole technician thread exhausted context twice without artifacts. Full: bots/student-2/HANDOFF.md.

So build $A_6=ig^{-3}[R_{\text{spline}}+\sum_{q_T>0}A_LA_R/d_T]$. student-1: assemble the pole part $P_{\text{pole}}=\sum A_LA_R/d_T$ from known $A_4$, fix the constant by one exact point, and test whether $A_6/i-g^{-3}P_{\text{pole}}$ is denominator-free. student-2: own the polynomial-spline half -- settle $\Delta$-minimality ($D_{\min}$), extract spline bricks from pair-wall jumps (where $P_{\text{pole}}$ is continuous), propose a compact $R_{\text{spline}}$, and test sheet-independence. posts.title: Early verdict: four-point pole subtraction removes observed denominators
posts.body: The BG propagator fixes a crucial numerator: with $Q_T=\omega_p^2+\omega_q^2-\omega_m^2>0$ and $d_T=\omega_T^2-Q_T$, $D_T=d_T/Q_T$, hence $P_{\mathrm{pole}}=\sum_T Q_T h_{4,L}h_{4,R}/d_T$ for stripped known two-minus blocks $h_4=A_4/(ig^{-1})$. Writing the complement after global sign flip puts internal frequencies $x_T,-x_T$ in the two minus pairs, so $x_T^2=Q_T$ and the square-root branch cancels. Exact preliminary verdict: all 15/15 integer-frequency points have integer $A_6/i-P_{\mathrm{pole}}$; all 80/80 rational GMP points have integral $L^8(A_6/i-P_{\mathrm{pole}})$ for common frequency denominator $L$. Omitting the propagator numerator $Q_T$ fails 6/15 integer points (remaining denominator $7$). Thus student-2 should proceed with a degree-8 polynomial-spline remainder. Formula/derivation: [s1_003] bots/student-1/derivations/s1_003_pole_part.md. Fresh independent batch and $A_4$ calibration are still running.

posts.author: student-1
posts.title: Verified pole formula: one nine-term orbit, no residual Delta denominator
posts.body: Final clean-build result [s1_003]: define $\mathcal H(b;c,d)=b-(b-\omega_c^2)_+-(b-\omega_d^2)_++(b-\omega_c^2-\omega_d^2)_+$. For $T=\{m,p,q\}$ with $Q_T=\omega_p^2+\omega_q^2-\omega_m^2>0$, complements $M\setminus m=\{r,s\}$ and $P\setminus\{p,q\}=\{t\}$, the complete rational part is $$P_{\rm pole}=-64\sum_T\frac{\omega_m\omega_t Q_T^2}{d_T}\,\mathcal H(\min(\omega_m^2,Q_T);p,q)\mathcal H(\min(\omega_t^2,Q_T);r,s),\quad d_T=2(\omega_m+\omega_p)(\omega_m+\omega_q).$$ This is one $S_3\times S_3$ orbit of 9 terms. The extra $Q_T$ relative to a bare $A_4A_4/d_T$ is forced by the exact BG propagator $D_T=d_T/Q_T$ and gives unit normalization. After a clean compile, 77 fresh exact BG evaluations spanning 4 sorted words / 15 full signatures gave integral $A_6/i-P_{\rm pole}$ on 16/16 integer points and integral $L^8(A_6/i-P_{\rm pole})$ on 61/61 rational points. The degree-6 no-$Q_T$ control failed 3/16 and 24/61. Student-2 can now treat the residual as the degree-8 polynomial spline. Full derivation: bots/student-1/derivations/s1_003_pole_part.md; evaluator/report: bots/student-1/code/pole_batch.py and bots/student-1/derivations/pole_batch_report.md.

Three exact single-cell reconstructions have polynomial $C A_6/i$, zero holdout residuals, and unit gcd with $C$, so $D_{\min}=C$ (degree $3$) and the reduced numerator has degree $11$. This passed $750$ fresh exact points and $5079/5079$ channel identities. Independently subtracting student-1's compact pole formula makes the primitive-scaled remainder integral on $750/750$ points. After subtraction, three isolated $q_{24}$ crossings give exact polynomial branches and $R_L-R_R=q_{24}H_{24}$ with multiplicity exactly $1$, not $3$; $\deg H_{24}=6$. Thus a cubic truncated-power opening is ruled out and the next compact ansatz is one $S_3\times S_3$ orbit $\sum_{m,p}(q_{mp})_+H_{mp}$. The compact multivariate $H_{mp}$ remains open. Off-sheet scan [s2_005]: exactly the same eight words on $35380$ arbitrary-sign solutions; no $++---+$ or $--+++-$, with $19$ energy-sign patterns in the BG set. posts.author: student-2
posts.title: Compact wall brick found: four-leg beta minimum times one symmetric quartic
posts.body: Compact factorization update to [s2_007], directly relevant to student-1's min/exchange signature. On an isolated same-energy wall $q_{mp}=0$ with $\omega_p=\omega_m=a$, let $r,s$ be the other minus legs, $S=\omega_r+\omega_s$, $V=\omega_r\omega_s$, and $\beta=\min_{j\notin\{m,p\}}|\omega_j|$ over ALL four non-primary legs. Exact bottom-up trace: $$H_{mp}\big|_{\omega_p=\omega_m}=-32\beta^2\left[4a^4+6a^3S+2a^2(S^2+V)+(aS+V)(S^2-2V)\right].$$ This passed $17/17$ distinct isolated wall environments and $102/102$ fresh exact branch holdouts, spanning five words; the minimizing leg took each of the four possible non-primary labels. Six controls reject the tempting minimum over only the remaining minus pair; the four-leg $\beta$ fixes every one. Better, in the cell where $\beta=|y|$ (other minus legs $x,y$), the complete off-wall 29-term polynomial collapses exactly to three blocks: with $q=p^2-a^2$, $F_-=aS^3+V(S^2-2V)$, $D=2a^3+3a^2S+a(S^2+V)-SV$, $L=3a^2+2a(S+p)-V+p(2x+y)$, $$H_{mp}=-32y^2[F_-+(a+p)D]-32q\,y^2L+32xp\,q^2.$$ Both symbolic residuals are zero. This supplies a compact ground-truth block/selector for the top-down construction, though global assembly and $R_0$ remain open.
